description: Westland Project Files hook — three-rule policy on the Westland share: (1) modify-prompt on any existing file (auto-mode cannot auto-approve); (2) version-controlled types (.xer, ...) hard-denied for in-place changes (force -vN versioning); (3) delete hard-denied (move to _Archive / _to_delete instead). Files outside the share are not affected.

hooks.command: python -c "import os,re,runpy;r=os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT'];m=re.match(r'^/([a-zA-Z])/(.*)',r) if os.name=='nt' else None;r=(m.group(1).upper()+':/'+m.group(2)) if m else r;runpy.run_path(r+'/hooks/check_xer_write.py',run_name='__main__')"
